method.allocation: Untimed production operation after physical compilation. CountingAllocator wraps System; qualified executable symbols verify malloc=mi_malloc and free=sf_free via native build aliases. Timed execution disables counts but retains the wrapper check. Requests/bytes exclude JVM/C++/other-thread allocations and are not retained memory or copied bytes.

limits: The initial correct native path loses to stock in 24 of 64 bulk cells and is retained as rejected performance evidence.
All qualified 64 bulk cells beat paired stock; all 16 tiny-batch cells remain slower because fixed Calc/result costs dominate.
Independent stock-control drift ranges from 0.611 to 1.638x. Separate before/after process timings do not isolate causality from variability.
Whole-job native medians improve 9.8-16.9% over previous StreamFusion but lose 9.5-11.8% to paired stock, with some overlapping ranges. These jobs are not a whole-job acceleration claim.
